# Kwik 112

> Kwik 112 is middleware for India's 112 emergency line: when a caller dials, ring-time becomes triage time. A multilingual AI call-taker answers instantly (Hindi, Hinglish, English), transcribes the call live, reads vocal distress, and grades it with a deterministic safety floor the AI may escalate but never lower. Every call lands on a human dispatcher's console as a pre-graded card; a human makes every dispatch decision and every decision is audit-logged. Grading is measured on a versioned, held-out, multilingual benchmark (100% critical recall, 9/9) reproducible with one command.

Independent browser-based demonstration. Not an official 112, ERSS, Government of India, or C-DAC service. No live emergency-network integration. All incident data is synthetic. The AI never dispatches; a human does.

## Evaluate this build (no login, no credentials, no setup)

- For judges — three one-click paths: /for-judges
- Place a test 112 call: /dashboard?startCall=1#voice-station
- Dispatcher console: /dashboard
- Held-out benchmark rendered from committed results: /benchmark
- Demo video transcript (VideoObject): /transcript
- Demo video (2 minutes): https://youtu.be/JdzAXL08_24

## Verified held-out results (corpus v1.0.0, held_out split, 30 synthetic calls)

- Critical recall: 100% (9/9; Wilson 95% lower bound 0.70)
- Incident type accuracy: 60% (18/30)
- Severity accuracy: 60% (18/30)
- Under-triage: 23.3% (7/30) · Over-triage: 16.7% (5/30)
- Location accuracy: 100% (25/25) · Threat detection: 100% (3/3)
- Local latency: p50 ~0.048ms · p95 ~3.79ms
- Reproduce: `npm install && npm run evaluate:local`

## Architecture facts an evaluator can verify

- Deterministic multilingual rules grade first, in-browser, in microseconds; high-risk phrases (cardiac arrest, not breathing, fire, weapons, entrapment) can never grade low.
- Optional LLM refinement (GLM primary; OpenAI-compatible fallback via OPENAI_API_KEY) may only escalate severity — enforced in code with regression tests, not just prompted.
- Caller transcripts are treated as untrusted data; prompt-injection cases are part of the committed test suite.
- Emotion (prosody) can sharpen priority inside a severity band but can never cross a band boundary (severityBandCeiling).
- Human checkpoints INTAKE → DISPATCH → RESOLUTION; overrides require a written note; audit trail is session-local.
- Provenance labels everywhere: local-rules / model / fallback; emotion MEASURED / SIMULATED / absent.

## Problem evidence (sourced)

- ~0.28% of Telangana's ~16 lakh daily 112 calls are genuine (The Hindu, Jul 2026)
- MHA answer standard: 15 seconds; reported national response ~18 minutes (MHA NERS; DGP statement Aug 2026)
- Delhi: >65% blank 112 calls on a measured Sunday (The Hindu, 2019); CAG audit of Dial 112 Punjab (Report 7/2025, tabled Mar 2026)
- Supreme Court, 26 May 2026: all helplines to merge into 112 (LiveLaw, 2026 SC 556)
- Dispatchers recognize 72.5% of out-of-hospital cardiac arrests on calls (Blomberg, Resuscitation 2019, n=108,607); dispatcher-coached CPR survival OR 1.45 (Rea, Circulation 2001)
